references.title: Bangalore Open Air
references.snippet: Bangalore Open Air is India's dedicated heavy metal and rock open-air music festival. This outdoor event features global headliners and powerful live acts, bringing together a community of metal fans for an afternoon of thunderous live music, bone-rattling riffs, and atmospheric heaviness. The festival is organized in collaboration with Wacken Open Air and is suitable for friend groups and families.

references.title: Marc Gonen
references.snippet: Music artist Marc Gonen performs live as part of his India Tour. This indoor nighttime event is geared towards friend groups and provides a lively atmosphere for fans of contemporary music. The performance takes place at an Asian restaurant and venue.

references.title: Bollywood Melodies With The High Octave
references.snippet: A live music performance featuring Bollywood melodies by The High Octave. This event explores the linear succession of musical tones and rhythmic phrases characteristic of Hindi cinema music. The show provides an indoor cultural experience suitable for friend groups and families, celebrating the rich musical heritage of India's Hindi-language film industry. Tickets can be booked online through BookMyShow.

references.title: The Dandiya Circle
references.snippet: A vibrant five-day Navratri celebration featuring Dandiya and Garba dance in an open rooftop setting with a bohemian theme. The event includes live Dhol performances, top DJs playing Hindi and Gujarati hits, and colorful festive decor. Guests receive free Dandiya sticks at the entrance and can enjoy live vegetarian food counters. The festival offers both afternoon and evening sessions with a festive atmosphere suitable for families and friends.
